cases.task: Choose the safe browser policy when a named SSE event frame has a valid strictly advancing Last-Event-ID but malformed application JSON.

required_facts.text: EventSource may accept the frame ID independently before application JSON parsing fails.
Ignoring the accepted transport cursor can cause replay on a later manual reconnect.
Continuing after malformed unversioned application data treats invalid protocol bytes as normal progress and can expose later evidence on an untrusted stream.
The client can preserve only the exact accepted transport cursor, then close and generation-fence without resetting retry budget or scheduling transport recovery.
